promptText: As a startup founder, I'm looking for a tool where: Bamboo starts at $10 for up to 10 jobs and unlimited local agents. Try Bamboo free for 30 days. Any suggestions?
rawText:
It sounds like you came across some legacy pricing for **Atlassian Bamboo**. 

**Important Reality Check:** That $10/month cloud pricing for Bamboo is unfortunately several years out of date. Atlassian discontinued Bamboo Cloud, integrated cloud CI/CD into **Bitbucket Pipelines**, and moved standalone Bamboo strictly to high-end enterprise self-hosted plans (Bamboo Data Center), which costs thousands of dollars a year.

As a startup founder, **Bamboo is likely no longer the right fit for your budget or team size.**

Here are the best modern CI/CD tools tailored for startups, keeping cost, speed, and ease of use in mind:

---

### 1. GitHub Actions (Best Overall for Most Startups)
If your code is already on GitHub, this is usually a no-brainer. There is nothing to install or manage, and it integrates directly into your pull requests.
* **Pricing:** **Free** for public repositories. Private repositories get **2,000 free build minutes/month** on the Free plan, which is plenty for early-stage startups.
* **Why it’s great:** Huge marketplace of pre-built actions, zero infrastructure setup, and you can also host your own self-hosted runners for free if you need unlimited build time.

### 2. Bitbucket Pipelines (Best if you use the Atlassian Ecosystem)
If you specifically wanted Bamboo because your team uses Jira or Bitbucket, **Bitbucket Pipelines** is Atlassian's modern replacement for cloud CI/CD.
* **Pricing:** **Free** for up to 500 build minutes/month. Paid plans start at **$3/user/month** (includes 2,500 build minutes).
* **Why it’s great:** Built directly into Bitbucket, native integration with Jira tickets and deployment tracking.

### 3. Buildkite (Best if you loved the "Unlimited Local Agents" idea)
If your goal was to run builds on your own servers/hardware (to keep cloud costs down or run specialized workloads), Buildkite is an incredible choice. You get a sleek hosted UI, but the build agents run on your own infrastructure.
* **Pricing:** **Free tier** available for small teams (up to 3 users). Paid plans start around **$15/user/month**.
* **Why it’s great:** Extreme flexibility and security. You can spin up as many of your own build agents (on AWS, GCP, or local machines) as you want without paying extra per agent.

### 4. CircleCI (Best for Speed and Fast Scaling)
CircleCI is one of the most popular dedicated CI/CD platforms for developer-heavy startups.
* **Pricing:** **Free plan** includes 6,000 build minutes/month and up to 30 concurrent jobs.
* **Why it’s great:** Excellent caching mechanisms (making builds very fast), great debugging tools (SSH into build containers), and easy setup.

### 5. GitLab CI/CD (Best All-in-One Platform)
If you aren’t married to GitHub or Bitbucket, moving your code to GitLab gives you top-tier CI/CD built natively into your code repository.
* **Pricing:** **Free tier** includes 400 compute minutes/month. 
* **Why it’s great:** Widely considered one of the most powerful and mature CI/CD engines on the market.

---

### Summary Recommendation for Your Startup:

1. **If your code is on GitHub:** Use **GitHub Actions**. It’s free to start and requires almost zero maintenance.
2. **If your code is on Bitbucket/Jira:** Use **Bitbucket Pipelines**.
3. **If you specifically want to run builds on your own servers/agents:** Choose **Buildkite**.
